app.name: Nudgy
app.tagline: Your buddy next to the cursor.

settings.title: Settings
settings.backendUrlHelp: Where Nudgy's server runs. Leave the default unless you host your own.
settings.voiceUnavailable: Voices load when the backend is reachable.
settings.hotkeyHelp: Hold to talk, release to send. Example: Ctrl+Alt+Space

caption.withheld: I skipped looking at your screen here to keep it private.

errors.no_speech: I didn't catch that. Hold the hotkey while you talk.
errors.no_microphone: I can't hear you — no microphone is available. Check your mic permission.
errors.backend_unreachable: I can't reach my server right now. Are you online?
errors.backend_error: My server had a hiccup. Please try again.
errors.auth_required: Please sign in to keep asking.
errors.limit_reached: You've used this month's free questions. Upgrade to keep going!
errors.stt: I couldn't transcribe that. Mind trying again?
errors.llm: My brain is a bit busy right now. Please try again in a moment.
errors.llm_refused: I can't help with that one.
errors.tts: My voice isn't working right now, so I'll just show captions.
errors.internal: Something went wrong on our side.

askBox.placeholder: Ask Nudgy anything… (Enter to send, Esc to close)
askBox.label: Your question

tutor.startHelp: Tell Nudgy what you want to learn. It will plan a short hands-on lesson and watch you do each step.
tutor.goalPlaceholder: e.g. Add up a column and format it as currency in Excel
tutor.orSay: Or hold your hotkey and say "teach me…"
suggestions: Add up a column and format it as currency in Excel
Change the font and size in Notepad
Open a new incognito window in Chrome
Cut a clip in DaVinci Resolve

say.planning: Great, give me a moment to plan this.
say.planFailed: Sorry, I couldn't put that lesson together. Could you try describing it differently?
say.stuck: If you're stuck, say skip and we'll move on.
say.verifyFailed: I couldn't check that just now. Say done when you're ready and I'll look again.
say.stopped: Okay, we'll stop here. Nice effort!
say.finished: You did it! That's the whole lesson: {{title}}.
